metadata.title: Third-Party Privileged Access

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for constraining, governing, and monitoring privileged access granted to third parties.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Third-party access management, privileged access management, and session governance technologies.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for limiting, supervising, and revoking elevated third-party access to institutional environments.

props.name: threat-framework
props.remarks: Third-party privileged access controls mitigate abuse of trusted relationships and credential misuse.

props.name: defense-framework
props.remarks: Third-party access governance aligns with identity restriction and access control defensive techniques.

metadata.remarks: Third-Party Privileged Access defines the capability to manage elevated access provided to vendors and external parties. Control realization is expressed at the capability level to ensure least privilege, accountability, and rapid revocation of third-party access.

components.title: Third-Party Identity Governance
components.description: Managed identity lifecycle for third-party and vendor accounts requiring elevated access.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Third-party identities are uniquely identified, authenticated, and governed.
Third-party accounts are explicitly managed, reviewed, and deactivated when no longer required.

components.title: Privileged Access Constraints
components.description: Enforcement of least privilege, scoped permissions, and time-bound access for third parties.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Third-party privileged access is limited to the minimum required to perform authorized tasks.
Remote privileged access by third parties is explicitly authorized and restricted.

components.title: Access Monitoring and Revocation
components.description: Monitoring, recording, and rapid revocation of privileged third-party access.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Privileged third-party access activities are logged and auditable.
Third-party access is promptly revoked when no longer authorized or required.
